decisions.Kwic: 函蓋乾坤事莫窮，頭頭物物露真風

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Sanshan Lai (三山來禪師語錄): in his Five Houses verses, Sanshan Denglai begins his verse on the first of Yunmen's three phrases by saying that the business of box-lid covering heaven and earth is inexhaustible.

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Sanshan Lai (三山來禪師語錄): after commenting on Yunmen Wenyan's one-word answer 'ancestor,' Sanshan Denglai introduces his own verse, repeats 'one-word barrier,' and asks why it is single rather than paired.

decisions.Kwic: 一指頭禪有甚交涉？賺殺阿僧終身活埋。

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Sanshan Lai (三山來禪師語錄): in his old-case comment, Sanshan Denglai asks what connection one-finger Chan has, says it buried the monk Juzhi alive for his whole life, and asks how many later finger-raisers actually received its use.
